---
applyTo: "src/i18n/**/*.ts,src/**/*.tsx,src/services/settings.ts"
---

# Internationalization instructions

- `src/i18n/en.ts` is the canonical key set because `TranslationKey` is
  derived from it.
- Add every new user-facing key to all 24 language dictionaries. Keep the same
  object shape so `Record<TranslationKey, string>` remains type-safe.
- Use `useTranslation()` and typed `TranslationKey` values in components.
  Do not add new hardcoded user-facing strings.
- Language display names are stable internal identifiers used by settings and
  the translation registry. Renaming one requires a migration for persisted
  `lumina-settings` data.
- When adding a language, update `LANGUAGES`, `LANG_TO_BCP47`,
  `src/i18n/index.ts`, and the Rust TTS voice map where applicable.
- Verify i18n changes with `npx tsc --noEmit` and inspect at least the English
  and affected-language UI.
